```yaml
rules:
- id: "vuln-aiohttp-1c335944"
  pattern: |
    unresolved_path = self._directory.joinpath(filename)
    filepath = self._directory.joinpath(filename).resolve()
    if not self._follow_symlinks:
      normalized_path = Path(os.path.normpath(unresolved_path))
      normalized_path.relative_to(self._directory)
      filepath = normalized_path.resolve()
    else:
      filepath = unresolved_path.resolve()
  pattern-not: |
    filepath = self._directory.joinpath(filename).resolve()
    if not self._follow_symlinks:
      filepath = unresolved_path.resolve()
  languages: ["python"]
  message: "Detected potential directory traversal vulnerability in aiohttp's WebUrlDispatcher. The `follow_symlinks` parameter was set to False, which could allow an attacker to access files outside of the expected directory."
  severity: ERROR
  metadata:
    source-url: github.com/aio-libs/aiohttp/commit/1c335944d6a8b1298baf179b7c0b3069f10c514b
    category: security
    cwe: CWE-22
```
